processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Steel ingot homogenized at 1200 ℃ for 2 h before hot rolling.
Hot rolled into slabs with a thickness of 20 mm.
Quenched in water; no subsequent solution treatment (original samples labeled S0).

structures.overall_structure: Single-phase face-centered cubic (FCC) austenitic matrix with uneven grain size (large deformed grains and fragmented small grains), nanoscale κ-carbide precipitates, and high dislocation density.

phases_present.morphology: Uneven grains: large deformed grains and fragmented small grains resulting from thermal deformation during rolling.
phases_present.texture: XRD pattern dominated by the (220) peak; EBSD IPF shows a non-uniform/bimodal grain distribution.

phases_present.morphology: Nanoscale precipitates with diameters ranging from 5 to 10 nm.

defects.dislocation_density: high density of irregularly distributed dislocations

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: Non-uniform/bimodal; a dominant bar at ~1–2 μm reaching ~59% relative proportion, with remaining bars below ~5%.

precipitates.distribution: Numerous, irregularly distributed in the austenitic matrix.
precipitates.coherency: γ/κ orientation relationship observed by HRTEM FFT: ZA_γ=[110] and ZA_κ=[110].

phase_interfaces.coherence: γ/κ orientation relationship (ZA_γ=[110] and ZA_κ=[110]) observed by HRTEM FFT

defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: S0 contains a substantial population of low-angle grain boundaries (LAGBs, 2–10°); dislocation tangles are observed adjacent to ATBs. ATB density 0.044 μm/μm² and HAGB density 0.035 μm/μm².

interfaces.phase_evolution: S0 retains uneven/deformed grains and κ-carbide precipitates and serves as the baseline before solution treatment.
interfaces.interface_notes: Average KAM value 1.62 (most pronounced residual stress among samples).

measurement_conditions.environment: 3.5 wt% NaCl solution, deoxygenated by bubbling pure N2 for 2 h
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Three-electrode system (Pt counter, SCE reference); potentiodynamic scan from 0.4 V below OCP to anodic current density 5 mA/cm² at 0.3333 mV/s.

corrosion_resistance.note: Highest breakdown current density among S0/S950/S1050/S1150; S0 is relatively more prone to corrosion.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: OCP measured for 3600 s; EIS frequency range 10^5 Hz to 0.01 Hz with 10 mV excitation.

corrosion_resistance.nyquist_observation: S0 displays the smallest capacitive arc radius in the Nyquist plot.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: After potentiostatic polarization at -0.5 V_SCE for 7200 s.

corrosion_resistance.nyquist_observation: S0 has the smallest capacitive arc radius, indicating poor protective performance of its oxide film.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: 30 × 25 × 3 mm samples; solution replaced every 7 days

corrosion_resistance.note: Highest corrosion rate among S0/S950/S1050/S1150, reflecting inferior corrosion resistance.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Potentiostatic polarization; stable current density after the initial transient.

corrosion_resistance.note: Highest stable current density among the samples, reflecting relatively weak protection of its oxide film.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Testing potential from −0.5 V to −1.1 V, scan step 30 mV/s.

corrosion_resistance.note: Highest N_D and N_A among the samples, indicating a more defective oxide film and inferior corrosion resistance.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: AES sputtering rate 3.6 nm/min; oxide film thickness defined as depth where oxygen concentration decreases to half of its maximum.

corrosion_resistance.oxide_film_composition: Mainly Fe, Al, and O; Fe and Al present in roughly comparable amounts.
corrosion_resistance.surface_Al_level: ~18 at.% (lowest surface Al among the samples, from AES depth profile)

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: XPS after 7200 s potentiostatic polarization in 3.5 wt% NaCl; spectra corrected using C 1s 284.8 eV.

corrosion_resistance.Al_valence_state: Al3+ (74.1 eV), attributed to Al2O3 and Al(OH)3
corrosion_resistance.relative_cation_content: Substantially higher Fe and Mn contents alongside a reduced Al content (exact S0 Al at.% not reported).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: corrosion resistance (corrosion rate, breakdown current density, polarization resistance)

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: XRD with Cu Kα radiation; scan range 30–90°, scan rate 4°/min
characterization_methods.purpose: Investigate crystal structure and phase composition
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 shows single-phase FCC austenite with (111), (200), (220), (311) peaks; the (220) peak is dominant in S0.
S0 grain size is uneven: large deformed grains and fragmented small grains resulting from thermal deformation during rolling.

characterization_methods.purpose: Grain size, misorientation (KAM), and grain-boundary distribution
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 has nonuniform grain-size distribution; average grain size 7.6 μm; average KAM 1.62; substantial LAGBs (2–10°); ATB density 0.044 μm/μm² and HAGB density 0.035 μm/μm².

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Double-jet electropolishing in 10% perchloric acid + 90% ethanol
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 contains numerous κ-carbides (5–10 nm); austenitic matrix with high density of irregularly distributed dislocations; dislocation tangles adjacent to ATBs.

characterization_methods.technique: Potentiodynamic polarization, EIS, potentiostatic polarization, immersion test
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: 3.5 wt% NaCl solution; three-electrode system (Pt counter, SCE reference)
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 has the highest i_bre (9.92 μA/cm²), lowest R_p (6036 Ω·cm²), highest stable current density (8.39 μA/cm²), and highest corrosion rate (0.326 mm/y).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ThermoFisher ESCALAB 250Xi, Al Kα anode, 72 W; Avantage software
characterization_methods.purpose: Analyze oxide film composition and valence states
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 oxide film contains Fe2+ (709.8 eV), Fe3+_OX (711.5 eV), Fe3+_hy (713.3 eV); Mn2+ (640.4 eV), Mn4+ (641.8 eV), Mn_sat (646.2 eV); Al3+ (74.1 eV); O1s OH-/H2O/O2-; higher Fe and Mn, reduced Al.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: ULVAC-PHI PHI-700, accelerating voltage 5 kV, sputtering rate 3.6 nm/min
characterization_methods.purpose: Depth-profile elemental distribution of the oxide film
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 oxide film thickness 16.2 ± 0.8 nm; mainly Fe, Al, and O with Fe and Al roughly comparable.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: Testing potential from −0.5 V to −1.1 V, scan step 30 mV/s
characterization_methods.purpose: Investigate semiconductor properties and defect (carrier) densities of the oxide film
characterization_methods.key_findings: S0 has the highest N_D (0.7 × 10^21 /cm³) and N_A (2.25 × 10^21 /cm³), indicating a more defective oxide film.

unmapped_findings: S0 (original sample without solution treatment) retains a substantial amount of κ-carbide, which limits the solid solubility of Al and yields the lowest Al content in its oxide film among the studied samples (b0121).

The exact Al cation fraction (at.%) of the S0 oxide film is not printed numerically; the text states only that S0 contains substantially higher Fe and Mn contents alongside a reduced Al content, while Fig. 14 shows the S0 Al bar at about half the height of S950 (near the 50 at.% gridline) (b0075, figure_014).
